correctness.rationale: On the \(c=1\) chart, direct expansion at \(B=[a:b:1]\) has no terms below degree three and gives \(T_3=-(bu-av)^3+bu^3-av^3\) and \(T_4=uv(u-v)(u+v)\). A fresh symbolic discriminant calculation gives \(-27a^2b^2(a-b-1)(a-b+1)(a+b-1)(a+b+1)\); cyclic charts therefore give the seven projective lines \(abc(a+b+c)(a+b-c)(a-b+c)(-a+b+c)=0\). Independent projective intersection enumeration gives exactly six triple and three double intersections, precisely the nine fixed \(B_3\) points. Specializing the published quartic at each of those nine points factors it into four distinct concurrent linear factors, proving multiplicity four there; away from the discriminant the binary cubic has three distinct tangent directions, and the displayed component factorizations give the stated triple-line versus double-plus-simple stratification.
residual_risks: Only the marked-point singularity and reduced discriminant support are classified; no scheme-theoretic discriminant multiplicities are asserted.
